clips.title: What has the Iran war got to do with the price of bread?
clips.quote: What does the war in Iran have to do with the price of bread? Unfortunately, a lot. You might already know that oil prices have jumped because tankers are stuck in the Persian Gulf. But here's what you might not know: a third of the world's fertilizer passes through that same narrow strait.
clips.speaker: Elena Casas

clips.title: What has the Iran war got to do with the price of bread?
clips.quote: Without it, crop yields will fall. Everyday staples like bread, pasta and potatoes will get more expensive. When Russia launched its full scale invasion of Ukraine back in 2022, fertilizer supply took a hit. Food prices jumped 11.4% in the U.S. that year and 15% in Europe.
clips.speaker: Elena Casas
